confidence_notes: Restaurant meal, coffee, and beer anchors come from web searches of aggregated cost-of-living sites (Mylifeelsewhere, Citycost, Livingcost, Borderly, That's Mandarin, Whereandwhen). These sources are partly crowdsourced, some are undated or out of date, and they disagree a fair amount. The beer anchor is a restaurant draft serving: higher than shop bottle prices (about USD 1) and lower than bar prices (RMB 40-80). Cocktail and wine are estimates based on how bar prices compare with beer prices in Chinese tier-1 and tier-2 cities, because the searches turned up no direct data for these. All accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge, with no booking pages checked. Suzhou has few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are less certain. July is summer peak season and may push room rates up.
comparable_city_reasoning: Suzhou is a wealthy Jiangsu city next to Shanghai with heavy domestic tourism. Its prices sit a little below Shanghai and are close to Hangzhou and Nanjing.
